question: What is the estimated worth of the National Monetization Pipeline unveiled by the Government of India in September 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹6 lakh crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Monetization Pipeline (NMP) was unveiled by the Government of India in September 2021.
 
• The NMP aims to unlock value in brownfield projects by engaging the private sector, transferring to them revenue rights but not ownership in the projects.
 
• The estimated worth of the assets to be monetized under the NMP is ₹6 lakh crore.
 
• The pipeline includes sectors such as roads, railways, power, oil and gas pipelines, telecom, civil aviation, ports, and warehousing.
 
• The initiative is expected to help raise resources for future infrastructure investment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brownfield Projects:**

 
 
• These are existing infrastructure assets that require investment for operation, maintenance, and expansion.
 
• Brownfield projects are less risky compared to greenfield projects as they already have an established structure and revenue stream.
 
 
 
• **Public-Private Partnership (PPP):**
 
 
• A collaborative investment model between government and private sector companies.
 
• It aims to leverage the efficiency, expertise, and capital of the private sector for public projects.
 
 
 
• **Asset Monetization:**
 
 
• The process of generating revenue through existing assets by transferring their usage rights while retaining ownership.
 
• It helps in efficiently utilizing underused or surplus assets.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure Development:**
 
 
• Essential for economic growth, infrastructure includes transportation, communication, sewage, water, and electric systems.
 
• Improved infrastructure leads to better connectivity, increased productivity, and higher quality of life.
 
 
 
• **National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP):**
 
 
• Another key initiative by the Government of India aimed at improving infrastructure in the country.
 
• The NIP includes projects across various sectors to be implemented over five years (2019-2025).
